item.title: United Way Seeks Volunteers for 33rd Annual Day of Caring
item.description: March 11, 2026 — The 33rd Annual Day of Caring, organized by the United Way of Fort Smith, is set to take place on Thursday, April 16, bringing volunteers together for a day of service across the Fort Smith region. item.description: March 13, 2026 — The Muldrow Public Library will host a week of creative activities during Spring Break as part of the Eastern Oklahoma Library System Spring Break Art Camp, scheduled for March 16–20.
